rationale: has_history/has_history_members mirrors the instrumented/instrumented_members pair, which renders exclusively in the totals line (workspace_activity.py:392/:436). Per-member rendering would be the first per-item boolean line in any formatter, needs suppression parameterization of the shared _activity_count_lines() helper to avoid totals double-render, and could only ever show the OK-branch True/False subset of the JSON signal.
rule: has_history renders totals-line-only in ll-history activity text/markdown formatters
alternatives_rejected: Option B (per-member has_history line in _activity_count_lines() plus totals extension): no boolean-line rendering precedent, double-render collision in totals, strict subset of JSON signal
